text: The Toronto Transit Commission Board in response to safety concerns and customer complaints approved at its December meeting banned lithium-ion battery powered micromobility devices, including e-bikes and e-scooters until April 15, 2025. The decision came after an incident in December 2024 involving a battery explosion and fire on a Toronto Transit Commission subway train, as well as several other similar incidents in Toronto. While the Toronto Transit Commission remains committed to improving the integration of cycling, micromobility and transit in Toronto, this ban supports the Toronto Transit Commission’s priority of putting the safety of employees and customers first. Lithium-ion batteries are known to pose a greater risk in colder months, resulting in a higher likelihood of fires.
